clips.source_title: Trials Evolution - D license test - HD Gameplay
clips.what: D License Test start: 3-2-1-GO countdown (1.0 s per beat), elevated start camera, first throttle burst off the pallet platform onto dirt.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution - D license test - HD Gameplay
clips.what: D License Test checkpoints 3/7-4/7: dirt riding with rear-wheel dust plume, scripted hard camera cut to a wide angle at a trigger volume, then wheelie-assisted climb of a wooden ramp.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution - D license test - HD Gameplay
clips.what: D License Test 5/7-7/7: dust-trail dirt roller section, jump past a fire barrel, drop to lower dirt, stop-sign obstacle, FINISH banner with 'New Bike unlocked' toast.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution - Level A License Test - HD Gameplay
clips.what: A License Test 1/5: two consecutive failed ramp-bunny-hops. 'CRASH!' text, ragdoll, then hard-cut respawn at the green checkpoint post ~1.0 s after the crash text; rider is rideable on the first respawn frame.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution - Level A License Test - HD Gameplay
clips.what: A License Test 3/5 'Obstacle Climbing': rider tucks forward, pops the front wheel onto the box lip, then balances on the rear wheel for ~4 s while modulating throttle to climb the container stack.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution - Level A License Test - HD Gameplay
clips.what: A License Test 4/5 'Jump Sequences': ramp descent, bail, checkpoint respawn, bunny-hop over gap landing rear-wheel-first on the next ramp, second bail and respawn.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution - Level A License Test - HD Gameplay
clips.what: A License Test 4/5-5/5: controlled ramp descent, drop off the tower, platform riding into the checkered RedLynx finish gate, FINISH overlay.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution - Gameplay (HD Warehouse) Beginner (No Commentary)
clips.what: HD Warehouse beginner track (PC Gold Edition) restart: READY (0.5 s) -> GO at t+0.9 s, timer starts on GO, rider pre-loads with a small wheelie off the line, first tabletop ramps in the warehouse.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution - Gameplay (HD Warehouse) Beginner (No Commentary)
clips.what: HD Warehouse beginner track 00:12-00:19: plank bridges with propane fireballs, half-pipe drum roll, warehouse floor sprint, finish-line fireworks flash and FINISH banner at 00:19.334.

clips.source_title: [Trials Evolution: Gold Edition] - All HD Warehouse Tournament Platinum Medals
clips.what: Gold Edition platinum run, same beginner track, 00:00-00:08: GO, immediate wheelie launch, full-throttle run with heavy directional motion blur, explosion barrel, smoke volumes.

clips.source_title: [Trials Evolution: Gold Edition] - All HD Warehouse Tournament Platinum Medals
clips.what: Gold Edition platinum run 00:09-00:16: fast plank section, half-pipe, finish gate. Lens flare from the finish light, checkered flag sweep, FINISH at 00:16.061.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution Playthrough - Part 4 - A LICENSE (medium tracks)
clips.what: Rock Steady (medium, Xbox 360) 00:05.6-00:13.6: dust-puff drops through a wooden gate, rocky gully, launch off the tall ramp, ~2.4 s airtime with camera pulling out and rotating overhead, rear-wheel-first landing with dust puff on the platform.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution Playthrough - Part 4 - A LICENSE (medium tracks)
clips.what: Roller Coaster (medium) 00:09-00:10.7: over-rotated landing, CRASH! text (0.8 s), player restarts: hard cut to start, READY sweeps in, GO 1.0 s later, timer resets. Ghost rider name tag 'Johnny Cullen' visible.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution Playthrough - Part 4 - A LICENSE (medium tracks)
clips.what: Roller Coaster (medium) GO to first big jump: 2.5 s of downhill wooden track, ~3.2 s airtime over the cabin, camera orbits from side to high 3/4 overhead and zooms out so the bike is ~15% of frame height, landing on the far curved ramp.

clips.source_title: Trials Evolution Playthrough - Part 4 - A LICENSE (medium tracks)
clips.what: Rock Steady first attempt: lands the big jump on the platform but loops out on the drop at 00:14.08, CRASH! text, READY appears 0.5 s later with the kinetic skew/scale text animation. Full-restart path.
